text:
Situation: Ceftriaxone sodium is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale Lakeside holds 37 vials of the 1 g injection (NDC 70518249900, labeled by REMEDYREPACK INC., manufactured by SANDOZ) with 4.2 vials used per day, giving 8.8 days on hand. Corvale East holds 253 vials at 12.9 vials per day for 19.6 days on hand. Corvale General holds 298 vials at 15.8 vials per day for 18.9 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show ceftriaxone sodium is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Lakeside's supply is below the two-week target. East and General have sufficient stock to support a transfer. Alternate manufacturers Civica, Inc. (Hikma Farmacêutica, Portugal), Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (ACS Dobfar SpA, last inspection VAI 2023-10-27), and Sandoz Inc. are not on FDA's shortage list today. Proficient Rx LP, a relabeler for a different NDC, has a registered plant inspected by FDA with VAI classifications in 2015 and 2022.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 22 vials of 1 g from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director approval (transfer request).
2. Transfer 22 vials of 1 g from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director approval (transfer request).
3. Buy from Civica, Inc. — needs buyer approval.
4. Buy from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC — needs buyer approval.
5. Buy from Sandoz Inc. — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
